request.statement:
You receive one recursive rule configuration and must convert it to a canonical indexed runtime form. Write one complete Rust program containing `fn main()`. Only the Rust standard library is allowed.

Names and labels are nonempty ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. `-` denotes omission. `@key` denotes a default reference.

Input starts with integer `N`, followed by exactly `N` nodes in preorder. Group child counts always describe exactly one structurally correct tree.

Node forms:

`G label D key1 value1 ... keyD valueD K`

A group has an optional `label`, `D` scoped defaults, and `K` children. Defaults are visible throughout its descendants; a nearer group shadows a farther one. Duplicate keys in one group are invalid.

Each default value is either a name or `@key`. References in a group are resolved simultaneously: `@key` refers to that group's default for `key` if present, otherwise to the nearest enclosing default. Following references must end at a literal name. A missing target is unbound; revisiting a default is a cycle. Resolved literal values are inherited by descendants.

`B key value label`

A boolean leaf has `value` equal to `0` or `1`. An omitted label becomes `key`.

`C key selected O name1 ... nameO L label1 ... labelL`

A choice has `O >= 1` ordered options. An explicit `selected` name is used; if it is `-`, the nearest resolved default for `key` is used. With neither, selection is absent. An effective selection must equal an option, whose zero-based position becomes its index. Duplicate option names are invalid. `L` must be `0` or `O`; when zero, option names become runtime labels.

Constraints: `1 <= N <= 200000`. The total number of defaults, options, and supplied option labels is at most `200000`. Input text is at most 8 MB.

Nodes are checked in preorder. Group checks prioritize duplicate keys, then examine defaults in listed order; the first whose reference chain is unbound or cyclic determines the error. Choice checks prioritize duplicate options, invalid label count, then unavailable effective selection.

On error print:

`ERROR code d p1 ... pd`

Codes are `DUP_DEFAULT`, `UNBOUND_DEFAULT`, `DEFAULT_CYCLE`, `DUP_OPTION`, `LABEL_COUNT`, and `UNKNOWN_SELECTION`. The root path has `d = 0`; otherwise components are 1-based child numbers.

If valid, print `OK N`, then one record per node in preorder:

`G label K`

`B key value runtime_label`

`C key index O name1 runtime_label1 ... nameO runtime_labelO`

An omitted group label remains `-`; an absent selection has index `-1`. Defaults and references are not output.

Output is compared by splitting only on ASCII whitespace bytes 0x09 through 0x0D and 0x20, then comparing all tokens exactly.
